integrations.rollbackMethod: No active skill tree was changed, so no backup or rollback was needed. For a future OpenCode tree replacement, restore the private full-tree backup to ~/.config/opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max; the .agents symlink will continue to resolve to it. Roll back Claude through its plugin manager, not by creating a second ~/.claude/skills installation.
